decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils. It also utilizes a strong board wipe in Supreme Verdict and strong creatures like Solitude and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck seeks to establish control of the game early on and maintain it throughout, using efficient removal and counterspells to disrupt the opponent's game plan and ultimately win through superior card advantage and board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief. The deck also features burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to remove threats and close out the game quickly. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide additional value by bringing back key creatures from the graveyard. Overall, the deck aims to establish board control and apply consistent pressure to secure a fast victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt opponents while dealing damage. It also incorporates cards like Thoughtseize and Seasoned Pyromancer for control and card advantage. The deck aims to pressure opponents early and maintain momentum throughout the game, with some powerful finishers like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The inclusion of cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice allows for flexibility and surprise plays, keeping opponents on their toes.

This deck utilizes the Amulet of Vigor to turbo ramp into Primeval Titan, allowing for explosive combos and powerful land drops. By utilizing bounce lands and utility lands like Vesuva and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, this deck can generate massive amounts of mana and put immense pressure on the opponent. With the ability to search for key pieces with Summoner's Pact and Expedition Map, along with the ability to protect your combo with Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, this deck can quickly overwhelm and outpace the opponent.

The key concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Aggro - Merfolk deck is to utilize Lord of Atlantis, Master of the Pearl Trident, and other Merfolk creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of powerful attackers. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Merfolk Trickster and Force of Negation to control the board and protect its creatures. With the support of Aether Vial and Cavern of Souls, the deck aims to apply pressure and maintain tempo to secure victory against opponents.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with the Cascade mechanic to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of powerful and disruptive cards. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cascade into game-changing spells like Crashing Footfalls and Subtlety. With a mix of control elements like Dead / Gone and Mystical Dispute, as well as creatures like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent, the deck is designed to apply pressure and disrupt opponents' game plans while overwhelming them with a relentless cascade of threats.

This control deck focuses on using powerful planeswalkers, versatile removal spells, and combo pieces to dominate the board and outvalue opponents. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Karn, the Great Creator to control the game, along with powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation, the deck aims to create a board state that is difficult for opponents to overcome. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of consistency to the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck prioritizes card advantage, removal, and efficient threats to control the game and secure a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively disrupt your opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt your opponent's hand, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to remove threats, the deck aims to control the board and secure a quick victory. Additionally, cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Blood Moon help to further disrupt your opponent's strategy and give you the upper hand in the match.

The deck focuses on assembling the Heliod Spike Feeder combo to gain infinite life and create an infinitely large creature. It utilizes cards like Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl, and Collected Company to ramp and find combo pieces efficiently. Auriok Champion provides protection and lifegain while Ranger-Captain of Eos helps tutor for key pieces. The deck also includes utility lands and a small subtheme of Lord of the Rings characters for flavor. Overall, the goal is to create an overwhelming board presence and outvalue the opponent with the combo.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by casting powerful cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Ardent Plea to quickly overwhelm opponents with creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Bonecrusher Giant. It also relies on controlling the board with cards like Subtlety and Leyline Binding to maintain its advantage. The deck's mana base includes a mix of fetchlands and shocklands to ensure consistent access to all colors needed for its spells. Overall, this deck aims to maintain pressure on opponents while disrupting their plans, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently cycle through cards and disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up for a powerful combo finish with Living End. Using cards like Grief and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan, and cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries to fill the graveyard, the deck aims to eventually cast Living End to bring back strong creatures like Oliphaunt and Striped Riverwinder for a devastating board presence. Overall, the deck focuses on resource management and timing to set up a game-winning combo.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, as well as removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Fury. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating value through cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Leyline Binding. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Nissa, Resurgent Animist. Overall, the deck relies on efficient control spells and strong threats to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once, overwhelming the opponent with a huge board presence. It utilizes various cycling creatures and cards like Violent Outburst to enable this combo quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Negation and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. Overall, the deck aims to win through a powerful combo while controlling the game with disruptive elements.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice can provide extra value by bringing back creatures from the graveyard. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can further enhance the deck's aggression and close out games quickly. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient threats.

The key theme of this deck is to aggressively control the game through disruption and removal spells while utilizing powerful and efficient creatures to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck focuses on a blend of disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate, alongside creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan and deal damage efficiently. Additionally, the deck includes elements of graveyard recursion and card advantage to ensure a steady stream of threats and resources throughout the game.

The deck revolves around assembling UrzaTron (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. With the mana produced, the deck aims to control the board using powerful cards like Karn Liberated, Oblivion Stone, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes utility cards like Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings to ensure consistency in finding the necessary pieces. Additionally, Karn, the Great Creator provides further control options and access to valuable artifacts like Relic of Progenitus and Walking Ballista.
